title: Commodities
source_name: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet)
note: Monthly physical-commodity benchmark averages; not live quotes or retail prices. Each series has its own grade, geography and delivery basis. Explicit futures/forward-month series, commodity indexes, and financial securities are excluded.

items.name: Gold
items.basis: Spot average of daily rates; pure gold benchmark.

items.name: Silver
items.basis: 99.9% refined silver; London afternoon fixing.

items.name: Platinum
items.basis: 99.95% minimum purity; spot average of daily rates.

items.name: Crude oil — average
items.basis: Equal-weight average of Brent, Dubai and West Texas Intermediate.

items.name: Crude oil — Brent
items.basis: U.K. Brent, 38° API physical crude benchmark.

items.name: Crude oil — Dubai
items.basis: Dubai Fateh, 32° API physical crude benchmark.

items.name: Crude oil — WTI
items.basis: West Texas Intermediate, 40° API physical crude benchmark.

items.name: Natural gas — United States
items.basis: Spot price at Henry Hub, Louisiana.

items.name: Liquefied natural gas — Japan
items.basis: Japan LNG import price, CIF; latest monthly values are estimates.

items.name: Tea — average
items.basis: Arithmetic average of Kolkata, Colombo and Mombasa/Nairobi auction quotations.

items.name: Tea — Colombo
items.basis: Sri Lankan origin; all tea; average weekly quotes.

items.name: Tea — Kolkata
items.basis: Leaf tea including excise duty; average weekly quotes.

items.name: Tea — Mombasa
items.basis: African origin; all tea; average weekly quotes.

items.name: Coconut oil
items.basis: CFR Northwest Europe.

items.name: Fish meal
items.basis: Herring fishmeal, 64% protein, FOB North Germany.

items.name: Groundnuts
items.basis: U.S. 40/50 runners, CFR Northwest Europe.

items.name: Groundnut oil
items.basis: Indian groundnut oil, refined, EXW.

items.name: Palm oil
items.basis: Malaysia crude RBD benchmark.

items.name: Palm-kernel oil
items.basis: Malaysia/Indonesia crude, CIF Rotterdam.

items.name: Soybean meal
items.basis: U.S. 48% protein, FOB Rotterdam.

items.name: Soybean oil
items.basis: U.S. crude degummed, FOB U.S. Gulf.

items.name: Soybeans
items.basis: U.S. soybeans, FOB U.S. Gulf.

items.name: Maize
items.basis: U.S. No. 2 yellow, FOB U.S. Gulf ports.

items.name: Rice — Thailand 5% broken
items.basis: White rice, milled; indicative export price, FOB Bangkok.

items.name: Rice — Thailand 25% broken
items.basis: White rice, milled; indicative export price, FOB Bangkok.

items.name: Rice — Thailand A1
items.basis: Thai A1 Super rice, government standard, FOB Bangkok.

items.name: Rice — Vietnam 5% broken
items.basis: White rice, milled; indicative export price, FOB Hanoi.

items.name: Wheat — U.S. hard red winter
items.basis: No. 2 hard red winter export price, U.S. Gulf.

items.name: Wheat — U.S. soft red winter
items.basis: No. 2 soft red winter export price, delivered U.S. Gulf.

items.name: Bananas — European Union
items.basis: Central and South American origin; Southern Europe wholesale/import benchmark.

items.name: Bananas — United States
items.basis: Central and South American origin; U.S. Gulf wholesale/import benchmark.

items.name: Beef
items.basis: New Zealand 90% chemical-lean beef, CIF U.S. import benchmark.

items.name: Chicken
items.basis: Frozen chicken consolidated wholesale price, São Paulo State, Brazil.

items.name: Lamb
items.basis: New Zealand frozen lamb cuts, CIF China import benchmark.

items.name: Oranges
items.basis: Mediterranean navel oranges, CIF Paris import benchmark.

items.name: Sugar — European Union
items.basis: Raw sugar import benchmark, CIF European ports.

items.name: Sugar — world
items.basis: International Sugar Agreement daily raw-sugar price, FOB Caribbean ports.

items.name: Logs — Africa
items.basis: Sapele, high quality, FOB Douala, Cameroon.

items.name: Logs — Southeast Asia
items.basis: Meranti; importers’ Tokyo sale-price benchmark.

items.name: Plywood
items.basis: Lauan, 3-ply; spot Tokyo benchmark.

items.name: Sawnwood — Africa
items.basis: Sapele, FOB Cameroonian ports.

items.name: Sawnwood — Southeast Asia
items.basis: Meranti, C&F U.K. ports.

items.name: Cotton
items.basis: Cotlook A physical cotton price benchmark; middling 1-3/32 inch, Far East C/F.

items.name: DAP fertilizer
